functions-model-the-callable-surface-thi.text: Functions model: the callable surface this ticket adds or changes.

This page owns only new or changed function names, their argument names, argument and result types, and signature-level constraints. It contains no bodies, no algorithm and no proof; the coder owns those. Only changed functions appear. Each group names its module in the modules model and the slice of the plan that adds it.

story.text: As the coder who ports the rule, I read the exact call surface the validators' authors and the conformance harness will depend on, so that I can implement it without choosing a name, an argument order or an error channel that a later ticket then has to reverse.

singularmodel-the-action-engine-and-the-.text: Singular.Model: the action engine and the mixed batch (slice four).

singulardriver-and-the-transport-slices-.text: Singular.Driver and the transport (slices two and four).

statements-the-coder-must-state-and-prov.text: Statements the coder must state and prove.
The names are fixed so that the register and the requirement pages agree. Each is a Lean statement of the requirement of the same name in the specification.

The statements are named as the earlier candidate named them, because the reviewed design is the reference; the coder may restate one only if the two-edge model makes the earlier wording false, and says which and why in the receipt.
